lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Cr2 (Mg7Cr) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Cr and Mg centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; the Cr centers have 2 Cr and 10 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments vary from 6 Cr/6 Mg to 10 Mg/2 Cr, with neighbor distances of 2.97–3.30 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
